toolsFoot: Re-run the plan a different way: alternatives, success odds, historical tests, sustainable spending, plan comparison, or one year worked in detail.
assistantTitle: Assistant — answers questions about this plan and shows its calculations
yourPlanTitle: Switch plans or edit this plan's numbers
undo: Undo — return to the previous saved plan
undoIdle: Nothing to undo — edits save automatically, and undo steps back through saved plans
footerPrivacy: Runs in your browser. Plan data stays on this device, except when a cloud model is used.
